mapper.select:
WITH selected_points(point_id,device_id,metric) AS ( VALUES (#{p.pointId}::text,#{p.deviceId}::text,#{p.metric}::text)
) SELECT s.dwbsm AS point_id,s.sbbsm AS device_id,s.jczb AS metric,max(s.jccjsj) AS latest_at FROM dwd_ql_jc_jcz_inc s JOIN selected_points p ON p.point_id=s.dwbsm AND p.device_id=s.sbbsm AND p.metric IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.jczb WHERE s.sscsdm=#{city} AND coalesce(s.sjtbzt,'')!='D' AND s.jccjsj IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.dwbsm,s.sbbsm,s.jczb ORDER BY s.dwbsm,s.sbbsm,s.jczb

SELECT DISTINCT p.bsm AS point_id,p.dwmc AS point_name,d.bsm AS device_id,d.sbmc AS device_name,d.jczb AS metric,NULL::text AS unit, d.sblx AS device_type,d.sbxh AS device_model,d.sbzt AS source_device_status,d.sjtbsj AS source_updated_at FROM point_bridge p JOIN device_source d ON d.dwbsm=p.bsm AND d.sscsdm=p.sscsdm WHERE p.bridge_id=#{id} ORDER BY p.dwmc,d.bsm

, threshold_latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON(sscsdm,bsm) * FROM dwd_ql_jc_jcxyz_inc t WHERE nullif(trim(bsm),'') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sscsdm,bsm,sjtbsj DESC NULLS LAST,(sjtbzt='D') DESC NULLS LAST,to_jsonb(t)::text DESC ) SELECT t.bsm AS id,p.bsm AS point_id,d.bsm AS device_id,t.jczb AS metric,t.sblx AS device_type,t.jcjb AS level, t.yzsx AS upper,t.yzxx AS lower,t.bjyz AS legacy_threshold,t.bz AS note,t.sjtbsj AS source_updated_at FROM point_bridge p JOIN device_source d ON ARRAY[p.sscsdm,p.bsm]::text[]=ARRAY[d.sscsdm,d.dwbsm]::text[] JOIN threshold_latest t ON ARRAY[t.sscsdm,t.sbbsm,t.jczb]::text[]=ARRAY[d.sscsdm,d.bsm,d.jczb]::text[] WHERE p.bridge_id=#{id} AND coalesce(t.sjtbzt,'')!='D' AND p.bsm=#{point} AND d.bsm=#{device} AND t.jczb=#{metric} ORDER BY p.bsm,d.bsm,t.jczb,t.jcjb,t.yzxx,t.yzsx,t.bsm

SELECT s.jccjsj AS time,s.jcz AS raw_value,NULL::float8 AS value FROM dwd_ql_jc_jcz_inc s WHERE s.dwbsm=#{point} AND s.sbbsm=#{device} AND s.jczb IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{metric} AND s.jccjsj BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND coalesce(s.sjtbzt,'') != 'D' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM point_bridge p WHERE p.bridge_id=#{id} AND p.bsm=s.dwbsm AND p.sscsdm=s.sscsdm) ORDER BY s.jccjsj,s.bsm LIMIT 2001

SELECT DISTINCT p.sscsdm AS city,p.bridge_id AS bridge,p.bsm AS point,d.bsm AS device,d.jczb AS metric FROM point_bridge p JOIN device_source d ON d.dwbsm=p.bsm AND d.sscsdm=p.sscsdm WHERE p.bridge_id IN #{id} FALSE
